intended_object: The finite Galois group Gal(L/k) = Aut_k(L) of a finite Galois intermediate extension L of K/k, regarded as an object of the category of finite groups (from the docstring and the profinite Galois theory module).
explanation: The body takes Gal(L/k) (i.e. L ≃ₐ[k] L) and bundles it as a FiniteGrp. The Fintype instance it needs comes from AlgEquiv.fintype, which uses the finite-dimensionality of L over k. This is exactly the finite group Gal(L/k), with no extra or missing conditions, in the general setting of arbitrary fields k and K with an algebra k → K.
